_comment: Source: https://imnoo.recruitee.com/api/offers/ — captured 2026-08-25, with rows borrowed from
the ethonai and climeworks boards so one fixture covers every case. parseBoard reads only
CUT: the ~40 application-form keys every offer carries (options_*, open_questions, translations,
dynamic_fields, mailbox_email, sharing_*), plus most of each description/requirements.
KEPT VERBATIM: id, title, careers_url, status, city, country, country_code, location,
published_at, created_at, and the description/requirements split.
ADVERSARIAL CASES, in order: (1) a Zürich offer whose `location` reads 'Remote job' — the city
must win over that display string — and whose requirements sit in their own field, so a parser
reading `description` alone loses the half that decides a match; (2) an offer Swiss ONLY via
country_code 'CH', which the word list cannot match unless it is spelled out; (3) a Berlin offer,
excluded; (4) a Zürich offer with status 'closed', which Recruitee leaves in the feed and we must
skip; (5) a Zürich offer with no published_at, so postedAt falls back to created_at; (6) a Swiss
offer with no careers_url, skipped without throwing.

offers.title: Product Operations Customer Manager
offers.description: We build software for the people who build the physical world. Your job is to make a tangible difference in manufacturing operations across Switzerland.
offers.requirements:
(at least 2 should match)

  • 3+ years in a customer-facing product role.
  • German and English.

offers.title: Senior AI Engineer
offers.description: Swiss only via country_code. The word list cannot match 'CH' unless it is spelled out first.

offers.title: Sorbent Characterization Intern
offers.description: No published_at, so postedAt falls back to created_at.

offers.title: Office Manager
